failure: Failure: This refutes a norm-only compression lemma and shows deletion rank is not a sufficient repair-cost statistic. It does not refute flexible stability for any particular group, establish a group-specific obstruction, or prove that all compression methods fail.
interface: Interface: P is an orthogonal projection of rank k, Q=I-P, and the compressed operator acts on Q C^n. Every normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm in this result uses denominator n, not n-k. The example is a finite-dimensional matrix construction.

claims.title: Polar repair cost is governed by leakage, not deletion rank
